stars: You are the best thing that ever happened to my camera roll.
If I had to do it all again, I'd still look for you in the same crowd.
You make normal days feel like a special occasion.
The museum has a security policy: no leaving without knowing you're loved.
I hope you know that you're somebody's favorite person. Mine. Obviously.
This little star is just here to say: I'm really glad you were born.

milestone.title: You've seen most of the museum.
milestone.message: I hope you know by now that none of this is here because I had to. It's here because I wanted to. There's still one room left — the one I was most nervous to build.
milestone.button: Take me to the last room

gift.title: A gift that doesn't fit in a box.
gift.message: I owe you a real one. Until then: a day where you don't have to decide anything, a meal that's entirely shrimp, and me, paying attention. Redeemable whenever you want.

cake.title: Make a wish, Love.
cake.message: Whatever you wish for, I hope it's the kind of thing that comes true quietly and then stays. And if it's fries, I can probably help with that part.

candles.title: You got them all.
candles.message: Officially a year older, officially still the cutest person in this museum. Confetti is only the beginning — happy birthday, Love.

final.heading: And that's my favorite exhibit.
final.supporting: Because at the end of the day, this whole little museum exists because of you.
letter: I built this whole thing because a card felt too small. There's no room on a card for the way you make an ordinary day better, or the sound you make when you're excited, or all the little things I want to say and never do.
So here it is: a whole museum. Every room is you. Every room is mine because you're in it.
Thank you for being the person I get to love. I hope this year is kind to you. I hope I get to be there for most of it.
final.closing: Happy Birthday, Love. I love you.
